# Python tooling for CI and for local checks.
#
# Install locally with:
#   pip install -r .github/requirements-ci.txt
#
# Pinned exactly: gdtoolkit ships new lint rules in minor releases, and an
# unpinned install would turn a green branch red without a commit touching it.
# Bump deliberately, run `gdlint .` and fix what it finds in the same PR.
#
# Dependabot does not watch this file (there is no pip ecosystem entry in
# .github/dependabot.yml), so this pin moves by hand.
gdtoolkit==4.5.0

# Used by .github/scripts/run_tests.sh to read GUT's JUnit report. Only the
# standard library is needed for that, so there is nothing else to pin here.
